prompt:
Wide 16:9 background illustration for a mystery adventure video game, no characters.
Scene: a quiet Japanese home dining room at dawn, seen from the doorway at table height. A plain wooden dining table with four simple wooden chairs; one chair is pulled back a little from the table, as if someone had been sitting there not long ago. The table top is bare and clean: only a folded cloth napkin and a small wooden tray, nothing else on it. A plain lace curtain with a simple geometric (not floral) pattern, the first pale morning light coming through it and falling in a long soft band across the empty table and the floor. On the wall a plain clock with a completely blank face and no hands, a sideboard with stacked plain white plates and bowls. Through the window, a grey-blue dawn sky and the dark roof of the house next door. Still, hushed, tender, a small mystery: the moment just after something quietly happened.
There are absolutely NO flowers, NO vase, NO plants, NO leaves, NO houseplants, NO trees visible through the window, NO botanical pictures, NO floral patterns on any fabric, dish or wallpaper, NO animals, NO people.
Accent colour of this case: rose red #E8435A, used only for a thin streak of the first warm sunrise light on the wall and on the edge of the table.
Art style: bold graphic-novel illustration, confident black ink linework, flat cel shading with subtle halftone screentone dots in the shadows, limited palette (ink navy #0B0D12, bone white #F2EFE6, cold teal shadows #1B3A44) plus the single accent colour given in this prompt, theatrical lighting, stylish and elegant, gentle, warm and quietly curious mystery mood, cozy rather than unsettling, suitable for children. Polished key-visual quality for a premium mystery adventure video game.
Composition: the key subjects are kept inside the central 60% of the width so the image can be cropped to a narrower frame, with clean readable depth and atmospheric perspective. No person.
Strict constraints: NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO numerals, NO writing of any kind, NO captions, NO speech bubbles, NO logos, NO watermark, NO signature, NO frame, NO border.
